01 · Research

From precise skills to complete behavior.

The benchmark paper and its accompanying technical notes.

Benchmark paper · ICLR 2027 submission

DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation

Haonan Ping, Jianshu Hu, Yimin Wang, Yi Zhu, …, Yutong Ban

Full author list

Haonan Ping, Jianshu Hu, Yimin Wang, Yi Zhu, Pai Liang, Qiyan Jin, Qirui Bao, Ying Qian, Xinyang Ding, Hongfei Qiao, Tianle Xue, Yucheng Bai, Soo Wei Jie, Shuguang Li, Yutong Ban.

Ten long-horizon tasks and thirty stage environments connect skill execution, visual generalization and bimanual composition through physically grounded success conditions.

11 September 2026Under review
Read paper ↗Leaderboard ↗
Evaluation note

One task contract. Three native scenes.

A shared factory standardizes robot setup, table placement and policy cameras across the 30 × 3 scene matrix.

Data note

Replay-validated demonstrations.

One hundred replay-successful episodes per stage retain the simulator state for restoration and offline rendering.

Baseline note

Six policies. Three evaluation tracks.

Compare PPO, RLPD, ACT, Diffusion Policy, GR00T and π0.5 on execution, scene transfer and full sequences.
